The Covid-19 pandemic impacted the music and arts community particularly hard. Musicians who had previously been interviewed for the Fillius Jazz Archive graciously shared their experiences during this virtual shutdown period.
Denis was interviewed via Zoom on August 18, 2020, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
Hi everybody. My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. I’m pleased to re- visit with Denis DiBlasio who is a performer, educator, and fellow Zoomer, not by choice.
As a matter of fact, isn’t there an Aretha Franklin song called “Who’s Zooming Who?” There is. I want you to Google that when we’re done.
So before we started recording you were talking about the plethora of meetings that you’ve been part of, just to kick off this unique semester.
